study_identification.author_journal_year: Fang et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2024
study_identification.title: Individualized gray matter morphological abnormalities uncover two robust transdiagnostic biotypes

study_characteristics.study_objective: To identify transdiagnostic subtypes based on personalized gray matter morphological abnormalities.

dataset_name.answer: UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP), Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE), Depression Imaging Research Consortium (DIRECT)

hc_sex.answer: Discovery (CNP): M 78.38%, Validation 1 (COBRE): M 68.49%, Validation 2 (DIRECT): M 34.66%

quality_checking_detail.answer: Participants with missing behavioral scores/images or signal dropouts in the cerebellum were excluded.

nm_vldtn_handle_ns.reason: The paper does not explicitly mention handling nuisance structure. It tries to avoid it by using single-site data.
nm_vldtn_handle_ns.supporting_text: The single-site dataset with the largest sample size (site 20) was used to prevent multi-site effects on the results.

nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.reason: The paper uses a subsampling method to validate the clustering results.
nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.supporting_text: Firstly, to ensure that our results were not influenced by a small subset of patients, we randomly selected 90 % of the patients and performed k-means clustering on this subsample, as done previously. We then calculated the Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) between the subtyping results based on this subsample and those based on all patients. This process was repeated 1000 times.

nm_vldtn_same_domain_indep.reason: The paper uses an independent validation dataset to replicate the subtypes.
nm_vldtn_same_domain_indep.supporting_text: Thirdly, we assessed whether the identified subtypes could be replicated in independent datasets. We used the cluster centroids of the two subtypes to infer subtype labels for patients with schizophrenia from another independent dataset.

nm_vldtn_diff_domain.reason: The paper investigates whether the subtypes could be generalized to an unseen psychiatric disorder (depression).
nm_vldtn_diff_domain.supporting_text: Furthermore, although the subtypes were based on patients with schizophrenia, ADHD, and BD, we investigated whether they could inform subtypes in unseen psychiatric disorders, such as depression. clinical_dataset.answer: UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP), Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE), Depression Imaging Research Consortium (DIRECT)

diseases_studied.answer: Schizophrenia (SCZ); Bipolar disorder (BD); Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD); Depression

clinical_groups_n.answer: Discovery (CNP): SCZ: 37, BD: 40, ADHD: 37. Validation 1 (COBRE): SCZ: 61. Validation 2 (DIRECT): Depression: 282.

clinical_groups_age.answer: Discovery (CNP): SCZ: 35.54 (9.08), BD: 34.78 (9.24), ADHD: 31.22 (10.11). Validation 1 (COBRE): SCZ: 36.57 (12.97). Validation 2 (DIRECT): Depression: 38.74 (13.65).

clinical_groups_sex.answer: Discovery (CNP): SCZ: M 57.50%, BD: M 54.05%, ADHD: M 51.82%. Validation 1 (COBRE): SCZ: M 78.69%. Validation 2 (DIRECT): Depression: M 35.11%.

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: k-means clustering, two-sample t-test, Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), HYDRA, multilinear model, dominance analysis, Pearson's correlation.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Two robust transdiagnostic biotypes with opposing gray matter morphological abnormalities were identified.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: The study identified two transdiagnostic subtypes with contrasting patterns of structural abnormalities. Subtype 1 showed predominantly increased GMV, while subtype 2 showed widespread reductions in GMV. These subtypes were reproducible and generalizable across datasets and disorders. Subtype 1 was associated with excitatory receptors, while subtype 2 was associated with inhibitory receptors and inflammation-related genes.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Limited number of psychiatric disorders, lack of clinical information (education, medication, etc.), and comorbidities not accounted for.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: The findings offer novel insights into psychiatric nosology and underscore the importance of considering transdiagnostic approaches in psychiatric research.

general_notes.general_notes: The study used a structural covariance network to identify disease epicenters for each subtype.
